title: 'weigh what this grief asks' at the drowned nave stated 'the saint's bell is yours' before the bell had actually been picked up — it still required a separate wits action ('guess where the bell would hang') to obtain, taken immediately after the weigh.
where: The Drowned Nave (Fenmarch) — 'weigh' action, before 'guess where the bell would hang'
